basic_details.scholarship_name: American University in Cairo (AUC) Graduate Fellowships
basic_details.offering_entity: The American University in Cairo (AUC) - Office of Graduate Studies
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: The American University in Cairo (New Cairo Campus, Cairo, Egypt)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Graduate programs across School of Sciences and Engineering (Computer Science, Robotics, Data Science, Mechanical Engineering, Environmental Engineering), School of Global Affairs and Public Policy (Middle East Studies, Sustainable Development, Public Policy), and School of Business.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~80 to 120 competitive graduate fellowships awarded per semester/year across all AUC graduate schools
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open globally; typically 4 to 8 Pakistani postgraduate students receive fellowships annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Standard duration of master's degree: up to 24 months (4 academic semesters) subject to satisfactory academic performance

nationality_requirements: Open to international applicants of all nationalities, including Pakistan
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No age limit under AUC graduate admissions policy.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16-year BS / BSc / BE) from an HEC-recognized university with strong academic standing (minimum CGPA 3.20 / 4.00 or 75%+; equivalent to US grade 'B' or 'Very Good').
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum CGPA 3.20 / 4.00; competitive applicants for full graduate fellowships typically hold CGPA >= 3.50 / 4.00.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Relevant undergraduate discipline with necessary prerequisite courses in computing, mathematics, engineering, or social sciences as specified by the academic department.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or enrolled in final undergraduate semester graduating prior to semester start.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior research assistantships, lab experience, or teaching experience strengthens application for graduate teaching/research fellowships.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.5 (writing minimum 6.5) or TOEFL iBT minimum 83 (writing minimum 22). MOI certificates are not accepted by AUC Graduate Admissions.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: All graduate instruction and examinations at AUC are conducted 100% in English.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Open equally to male and female applicants.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Merit-based academic fellowship combined with graduate teaching (GA) or research assistantship (RA) responsibilities.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold multiple full institutional fellowships concurrently.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition waiver covering up to 9 graduate credit hours per semester plus remedial English coursework if required (worth ~$15,000 to $20,000 / year).

admission_application_fee.details: Online graduate application fee of USD 50 (~PKR 14,000) payable via credit card on the AUC application portal.

accommodation.details: Subsidized accommodation provided at AUC on-campus Student Residences in New Cairo, or monthly housing stipend contribution.

monthly_stipend.details: EGP 15,000 to 20,000 / month living stipend (~PKR 85,000 to 115,000 / month) provided in exchange for 15-20 hours/week of academic departmental service.

airfare.details: International travel between Pakistan and Cairo International Airport is self-funded.

visa_fee.details: Egyptian student residence visa facilitated and sponsored by AUC Business Support and International Students Office.
visa_fee.amount: Egyptian student visa sponsored by AUC

health_insurance.details: Full comprehensive medical insurance plan covering on-campus clinic consultations, emergency treatment, and hospital network in Cairo.

food_allowance.details: Subsidized dining options across New Cairo campus student center and food court.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full digital access to AUC Library (largest English-language library in Egypt), JSTOR, ScienceDirect, and engineering laboratories.
books_and_materials_allowance.amount: Full university library and lab access

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Access to graduate research support grants, thesis laboratory materials, and conference travel grants up to $1,000 from the Office of Associate Provost for Research.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Subsidized AUC air-conditioned bus transportation network operating across Greater Cairo and the New Cairo campus.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single host university (The American University in Cairo - AUC, New Cairo, Egypt).
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: #1 university in Egypt, top 400 globally (QS World University Rankings 2025); US-accredited by Middle States Commission on Higher Education (MSCHE); engineering programs ABET-accredited.
available_majors: MSc in Robotics, Control & Smart Systems (RCSS)
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: HEC-recognized Bachelor's degree (CGPA >= 3.20/4.00), IELTS 6.5+ (writing 6.5+) or TOEFL 83+ (writing 22+), statement of purpose, two letters of recommendation, and completed AUC fellowship application.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Apply for graduate admission by January 15 for Fall intake; once admitted, submit the graduate fellowship online application before April 1.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Highlight specialized research interests connecting to regional challenges such as water security, renewable energy, AI for heritage preservation, or Middle Eastern socio-economics.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: AUC Graduate Application System & Banner Self-Service
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Step 1: Create an account on the AUC Graduate Admissions portal (aucegypt.edu/apply-now) and submit program application with $50 fee by January 15. Step 2: Once admitted, log into Banner Self-Service and submit the Graduate Fellowship application before April 1.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Explore graduate programs and faculty research profiles on aucegypt.edu.
Step 2: Submit graduate degree application via AUC online admissions portal before January 15 (Fall intake) or October 1 (Spring intake).
Step 3: Upload transcripts, degree certificates, CV, statement of purpose, and English proficiency test scores.
Step 4: Pay non-refundable application fee of USD 50.
Step 5: Receive formal notification of graduate admission from AUC Office of Graduate Admissions.
Step 6: Access the AUC Graduate Fellowships portal and select eligible fellowship categories (e.g. University Fellowships, Departmental Fellowships).
Step 7: Upload fellowship essays and research statement before the fellowship deadline (April 1).
Step 8: Graduate Studies Committee evaluates academic merit, departmental needs, and faculty nominations.
Step 9: Fellowship award notifications dispatched by early June.
Step 10: Accept fellowship contract, complete Egyptian student visa paperwork, and enroll in courses.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Separate Routing: Candidates must first be accepted into an AUC graduate degree program before submitting the graduate fellowship application.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted directly online by two academic referees via automated confidential appraisal system.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of purpose (500-750 words) detailing academic background, intellectual interests, reasons for choosing AUC, and career goals.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: 1 to 2-page research interest statement outlining proposed thesis topic and preferred faculty advisors.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Detailed academic CV highlighting education, research projects, technical skills, publications, and extracurriculars.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Online departmental interview (20-30 minutes) with graduate program director or prospective research supervisor.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic 6.5+ (min 6.5 writing) or TOEFL iBT 83+ (min 22 writing); GRE required for selected engineering and business tracks.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC Pakistan, MoFA Pakistan, and Egyptian Embassy attestation required for official degree registration.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translation for all official records not originally issued in English.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via AUC Graduate Admissions portal and Banner Self-Service.

required_documents_checklist.specification: HEC-attested undergraduate degree in relevant academic field with minimum CGPA 3.20 / 4.00.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by HEC and MoFA Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete consolidated grade transcript covering all undergraduate semesters.
Statement (500-750 words) explaining academic goals, intellectual curiosity, and fit with AUC faculty.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Highlight focus on AUC research areas.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Essay submitted via Banner portal addressing eligibility and teaching/research assistantship qualifications.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Describe prior lab or teaching experience.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Detailed academic CV highlighting qualifications, project work, technical toolsets, and awards.
Letters from university professors assessing intellectual capacity and postgraduate research promise.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: On official institutional letterhead with verified contact details.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official IELTS (min 6.5 with 6.5 writing) or TOEFL iBT (min 83 with 22 writing) scorecard.
Clear scan of passport identification page valid for at least 18 months.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Fall cycle opens December 1; degree admission closes January 15; fellowship application closes April 1. Spring cycle opens September 1.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 45% (Undergraduate GPA, academic ranking, and foundational coursework performance)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 20% (Quality of final year project, research publications, or laboratory experience)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 15% (Clarity of intellectual purpose and alignment with AUC research programs)
selection_process_and_weights.financial_need_weight: 0% (Merit-based competition assessing intellectual promise and teaching/research utility)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: AUC Graduate Studies Committee, Associate Provost for Research, and Department Chairs.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Rigorous departmental ranking based on GPA, GRE (where applicable), research alignment, and referee appraisals.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~1,800 to 2,500 international and Egyptian applicants for graduate fellowships
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~5% to 7% among qualified applicants with CGPA >= 3.50 / 4.00
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates in computer science, robotics, mechanical engineering, or sustainable development with strong theoretical fundamentals, coding/lab proficiency, and teaching potential.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from NUST, LUMS, FAST-NUCES, GIKI, and Quaid-i-Azam University.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Egypt, Pakistan, Palestine, Jordan, United States, Nigeria, Germany.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only apply through official AUC website https://www.aucegypt.edu/.
Beware of third-party education agencies in South Asia charging money for AUC admissions.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Standard graduate application fee is USD 50 paid directly to AUC; fellowship application itself has no extra charge.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: AUC strictly evaluates applications directly; third-party commercial intermediaries are unauthorized and will jeopardize admission.
hidden_costs_breakdown: HEC and MoFA document attestations in Pakistan: ~PKR 15,000 - 25,000.
Living expenses beyond stipend: ~USD 100 - 150 / month if living in off-campus private housing.
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: AUC is a state Egyptian university taught in Arabic. Reality: AUC is an independent, American-accredited institution where 100% of instruction and administration are in English.
Myth: Fellowships cover unlimited credit hours. Reality: Fellowships cover up to 9 credit hours per semester, which is the standard full-time graduate load.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial forums suggest IELTS 6.0 is sufficient; AUC strictly enforces IELTS 6.5 with at least 6.5 in the writing module for graduate matriculation.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.20 / 4.00 (grade 'B' or better) each semester.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time graduate study; fulfilling 15 to 20 hours per week of assigned teaching or research assistantship duties.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: End-of-semester performance evaluation by the academic department and Office of Graduate Studies.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Fellows cannot engage in outside full-time employment without written authorization from the Dean of Graduate Studies.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; zero service bond or mandatory return obligation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Graduate Teaching Assistant (GTA) or Graduate Research Assistant (GRA) duties (15-20 hours/week) during academic semesters.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Fellowship terminated if cumulative GPA falls below 3.20, or in cases of unsatisfactory assistantship performance or academic misconduct.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing graduate program requires re-evaluation and approval by the new department and Graduate Studies Committee.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Standard fellowship duration is 4 semesters (2 years); 5th semester extension granted only under exceptional academic justification.
